Precompute the geometry of light interception in a stand

Source: R/precompute_sl_geometry.R
precompute_sl_geometry.Rd

Runs, once for a given stand, the part of the SamsaRaLight ray tracing that does not depend on the crown leaf area density (LAD) or openness: for each ray toward each target (sensor or cell), the crowns crossed by the ray, the path length across each crown, and whether a trunk intercepts the ray. The light reaching the targets can then be estimated very quickly for any crown LAD or openness with estimate_pacl_from_geometry, e.g. when calibrating crown LAD from light measurements, where the same stand is run many times with different LAD values.

Usage

precompute_sl_geometry(
  sl_stand,
  monthly_radiations,
  sensors_only = FALSE,
  use_torus = TRUE,
  height_anglemin = 10,
  direct_startoffset = 0,
  direct_anglestep = 5,
  diffuse_anglestep = 15,
  soc = TRUE,
  start_day = 1,
  end_day = 365,
  parallel_mode = FALSE,
  n_threads = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

sl_stand

An object of class "sl_stand" describing the forest stand, typically created with create_sl_stand. It contains tree, sensor, terrain, and grid geometry information (see validate_sl_stand).

monthly_radiations

A data frame containing monthly horizontal radiation (Hrad, in MJ m\(^{-2}\)) and diffuse-to-global radiation ratio (DGratio), typically obtained with get_monthly_radiations. The input is validated internally using check_monthly_radiations.

sensors_only

Logical. If TRUE, compute light interception only for sensors. This can substantially reduce computation time when only sensor-level results are required. Defaults to FALSE.

use_torus

Logical. If TRUE, use a torus system to handle stand borders. Defaults to TRUE.

height_anglemin

Numeric. Minimum altitude angle of rays, in degrees. Defaults to 10.

direct_startoffset

Numeric. Starting angle of the first direct ray, in degrees. Defaults to 0.

direct_anglestep

Numeric. Angular step between direct rays, in degrees. Defaults to 5.

diffuse_anglestep

Numeric. Angular step between diffuse rays, in degrees. Defaults to 15.

soc

Logical. If TRUE, use the Standard Overcast Sky model; if FALSE, use the Uniform Overcast Sky model. Defaults to TRUE.

start_day

Numeric. First day of the simulated vegetative period, between 1 and 365. Defaults to 1.

end_day

Numeric. Last day of the simulated vegetative period, between 1 and 365. Must be greater than or equal to start_day. Defaults to 365.

parallel_mode

Logical. If TRUE, ray–target computations are parallelised using OpenMP. If FALSE, the model runs in single-thread mode. BLAS is automatically forced to single-thread mode during the simulation to avoid competition between BLAS and OpenMP. Parallel execution can substantially reduce computation time for large stands or fine ray discretization. Defaults to FALSE.

n_threads

Integer or NULL. Number of CPU threads to use when parallel_mode = TRUE. If NULL, OpenMP automatically selects the number of available threads. If supplied, must be a positive integer. Defaults to NULL.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, print informative messages during the simulation, including OpenMP status. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

An object of class "sl_geometry" (a list), to be used in estimate_pacl_from_geometry, and that can be saved with saveRDS(). It contains:

  • sensors, cells: The geometry toward the sensors and the cells (NULL if there are no sensors, or if sensors_only = TRUE for the cells). Each one is a list with:

    • targets: One row per target (id_sensor or id_cell), with the energy of the rays reaching the target without crossing any crown or trunk (e_unobs_direct, e_unobs_diffuse, in MJ/m2 on a horizontal plane for sensors and on the slope plane for cells, as in run_sl_advanced).

    • pairs: One row per ray x target pair intercepted at least once by a crown or a trunk, with the index of the target (target, row in targets) and of the ray (ray, row in rays), whether a trunk intercepts the ray (blocked), and the number of crowns crossed (n_trees).

    • crossings: One row per crown crossed by the ray of a pair, with the index of the pair (pair, row in pairs), of the tree (tree, row in sl_stand$trees) and the path length across the crown (length, in m, summed over crown parts).

  • rays: One row per ray, with its energy above the canopy (in MJ/m2, on a horizontal plane e_horizontal and on the slope plane e_slope) and its type (direct).

  • id_tree: Identifiers of the trees, in the order of sl_stand$trees (order of the crown LAD or openness to give in estimate_pacl_from_geometry).

  • energies: Energies above the canopy, as computed for run_sl_advanced.

  • params: The settings used to compute the geometry.

The object should not be modified: filter the output of estimate_pacl_from_geometry instead.

Details

The energy reaching a target does not depend on the order in which a ray crosses the crowns: it is the energy of the ray above the canopy times the product of the transmittances of the crossed crowns (Beer-Lambert law for a turbid medium, crown openness for a porous envelope), and is null if a trunk intercepts the ray. The light on sensors and cells estimated by estimate_pacl_from_geometry is thus the same as with run_sl_advanced (up to rounding errors) for the same stand, radiations and ray settings. The light intercepted by trees (e, epot, lci, ...) depends on the order of interceptions and cannot be estimated from the geometry.

The geometry depends on the stand (tree positions, dimensions and crown shapes, sensors, cells), the radiations and the ray settings, but not on the crown LAD and openness, the extinction coefficient, the clumping factor or the interception by trunks, which are chosen in estimate_pacl_from_geometry. The geometry must be computed again if the stand, the radiations or the ray settings change. Trunks are always included in the geometry.

The size of the geometry increases with the number of targets, rays and crowns crossed by each ray: use sensors_only = TRUE if the light on the cells is not needed.

See also

estimate_pacl_from_geometry, run_sl_advanced

Examples

data_prenovel <- SamsaRaLight::data_prenovel

stand <- create_sl_stand(
  trees_inv = data_prenovel$trees,
  cell_size = 10,
  latitude = data_prenovel$info$latitude,
  slope = data_prenovel$info$slope,
  aspect = data_prenovel$info$aspect,
  north2x = data_prenovel$info$north2x
)
#> SamsaRaLight stand successfully created.

geometry <- precompute_sl_geometry(
  sl_stand = stand,
  monthly_radiations = data_prenovel$radiations
)
#> parallel mode: DISABLED | Threads = 1 (user) | Cores available = 4
#> SamsaRaLight geometry was computed successfully.

str(geometry, max.level = 2)
